references.text: The first time the physical parents are called in to confirm the healing of the blind man, before the religious leaders question them again in this verse.
The parents confirm that their son was blind and was healed, but refuse to testify about Jesus due to fear of excommunication, which explains their hesitant answer in verse 18.
The religious leaders call the healed man in for a new interrogation and demand that he give glory to God, while he maintains that Jesus did it, in contrast to the parents' fear.
The consequence of refusing to believe in Jesus and acknowledge his miracle is excommunication, which the parents feared in verse 18.
A parallel situation where many believed in Jesus but did not confess it publicly due to fear of the religious leaders, just like the parents in chapter 9.
